paragraphs: R' Pinchas, son of R' Shimon.
He is mentioned in Yalkut, Ruth, remez 605; but in Ruth Rabbah, end of chapter 6, the reading is R' Pinchas bar Chama.[^1][^2]

notes.text: תרה totals 605. ברו״ר is contextually Ruth Rabbah and סוף פ״ו gives end of chapter 6, without independent numbering/edition verification.

The source supplies Yalkut Ruth, without Shimoni; the earlier bracketed work gloss remains withdrawn. Hyman contrasts son of R' Shimon with bar Chama. The father’s title component is retained in the first reading and not added to Chama. All three title abbreviations remain R', without identity merger or fresh variant collation.
